summary: First-finish smoke test for RENFFR OPEN tennis web-app. Backend endpoints (matches CRUD, filters, leaderboard) and frontend flows (Home -> Setup -> Play -> Pause, Leaderboard, History) all verified working against public URL.
passed: POST /api/matches hard win -> rating_points=35; easy loss -> rating_points=2 (matches spec 10/20/35/60 + 2)
GET /api/matches returns newest first (verified by created_at ordering)
GET /api/leaderboard aggregates per player with wins/losses/win_pct/rating/best_rally/aces/perfect_shots/legend sorted by rating desc
Home '/' loads with home-play-btn, home-renffr-tribute, nav-renffr-badge all visible
Setup '/setup' option buttons (difficulty-easy, style-baseline, surface-clay, format-quick) clickable; setup-legend-renffr-toggle present and clickable
Play '/play' game-canvas renders; scoreboard-points-0/1 and scoreboard-games-0/1 readable; rally-count increments to '2' after Digit6 serve+strike sequence
Pause via Escape shows pause-modal; pause-resume-btn works
History '/history' player filter input and surface filter buttons (all/hard/clay/grass) all visible
No console/page errors observed during flow
notes: History page briefly shows 'Loading...' before data arrives (~360ms API latency) — not a defect. Test matches (TEST_renffr, TEST_other) were cleaned from DB after testing. Full match-end save flow was validated at API layer; running a full in-game match to end was not performed due to time (deferred to full QA).
